items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29
items.q: You got Nat King Cole coming in.

ctx.x: Okay, real number four with Tex Stevens, and this is still August 29th, 1995. Okay, uh, yeah, uh, where were we? Were we talking about Frank Panae? We were moving along. Well in 19...

...his... Right after the soldiers started coming home, and then some soldiers were passing through, and like we said, things were not as integrated as they are now, and people wanted to... People had a few money. Some people were covered being, uh, turned loose and normal with three, four, five, six hundred dollars, which was a lot of money. Remember, Coca-Cola was 25 cents, uh, Coca-Cola was five cents a bottle. You could get a half a pint of liquor for 45 cents, along with a seven-up of Coke and a pitcher of…
He had the whole package. He had the package.
